meta.name: product-manager-toolkit
meta.description: Comprehensive toolkit for product managers including RICE prioritization, customer interview analysis, PRD templates, discovery frameworks, and go-to-market strategies. Use for feature prioritization, user research synthesis, requirement documentation, and product strategy development.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用框架和模板系统化推进产品管理工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是产品经理，需要结构化工具来管理需求、分析和策略。
copy.tagline_en: Systematize product management with frameworks and templates
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a product manager needing structured tools for requirements, analysis, and strategy.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能运行 RICE 优先级脚本给功能打分排序,能分析客户访谈文本提取痛点、需求、情感等洞察,还能套用多种 PRD 模板生成需求文档。
howto.when: 当用户要求功能优先级排序、分析客户访谈记录、编写 PRD 文档等产品管理任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这几个功能用 RICE 方法做优先级排序
say.note: 会调用 rice 脚本计算得分并输出排序

say.text: 分析这份客户访谈记录,提取关键痛点和需求
say.note: 会调用访谈分析脚本生成洞察

say.text: 用标准 PRD 模板写一份需求文档

howto.what_en: Claude can run the RICE script to score and rank features, analyze interview transcripts for pain points and insights, and generate PRDs from templates.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for feature prioritization, customer interview analysis, or PRD writing.

say_en.text: Use RICE to prioritize these features.
Analyze this customer interview transcript for pain points and needs.
Write a requirements doc using the standard PRD template.
